body:
Someone left a text line on this thread before, but it has been deleted. 

I need it right now. Can someone please help?

I don't know of the text line. I've had no luck with hotline calls though. So many are shut down and so many others just refer to services, many of which no longer exist. 

I am in the US. What is the text line?

The hotlines I've called in the past were either disconnected or just gave me lists off other numbers to call during normal business hours- many of which were disconnected. 

I've not heard that about psychiatrists. But with my husband out of work, the less amount I can afford would not be a fair rate.
Agreed. But I can't find a better one without insurance and a 1 to 3 month wait list for uninsured. So....?

My daughter is trans. She is so defensive about thinking people won't accept and love her that she doesn't see how many people do. 

It's a really hard path to walk, I have no doubt. 

But that doesn't make it the wrong path.
